from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional, List

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A named party involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the person or entity")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Legal role, e.g., 'Appellant', 'Defendant', 'Plaintiff'")

class FinancialItem(BaseModel):
    """A monetary value mentioned in the judgment."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The specific amount string, e.g., '65000 元'")
    purpose: str | None = Field(description="What the money is for, e.g., 'Court fee', 'Returned gift'")

class DocumentExtraction(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document."""
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case (e.g., Civil, Criminal, Property) and cause")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the court")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="Official case number")
    instance_level: str | None = Field(description="Instance of court (e.g., First Instance, Second Instance)")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of all parties named in the document")
    financial_items: list[FinancialItem] = Field(description="List of all specific monetary amounts and obligations in the ruling")
    primary_outcome: str | None = Field(description="Core ruling action, e.g., 'Maintain original', 'Retrial ordered'")
    distinctive_phrases: list[str] = Field(description="Unique text strings that help distinguish this result (e.g., specific amounts, names)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentExtraction]
